strings.CnvQstEditor — Grim Dawn .cnv / .qst edi:
CnvQstEditor — Grim Dawn .cnv / .qst editor

View, edit, create, import/export and batch-process; the format is based on reverse-engineering the Game.dll loader and 447 verified samples.

Three checks run before saving (records tile the file / localization offset / round-trip bytes). A structurally valid file is not necessarily semantically correct;
after changing yellow unknown-semantics fields, verify in game or the official editor.
